Axiom: A non-functional constraint is a number plus its measurement condition: latency as a percentile under stated load (`p95 ≤ 200ms @ 100 RPS`), availability as a target with an error budget, scale as concrete volumes (rows, RPS, concurrent users, growth horizon), consistency as a named model. «Fast», «reliable», «scales» are placeholders, not constraints — replace each with a measurable budget, or record an explicit «не бюджетируем, потому что …» decision.
